About Saffron Ledger

Saffron Ledger builds reliable, human-centered software and analytical platforms used by teams across universities, financial institutions, and distributed engineering organizations. We value clear written communication, careful engineering, and measurable outcomes over buzzwords.

Role Overview: Risk Analytics Associate (New Grad)

As a Risk Analytics Associate (New Grad) at Saffron Ledger, you will collaborate with product engineers, data scientists, and operations leads to design, test, and ship production workflows. You will participate in weekly design reviews, write well-documented code and unit tests, monitor service reliability, and help improve internal developer tooling.

Requirements & Qualifications

Graduating in 2027. Closing date: December 21, 2026.
